item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Multi-disk crash-consistent VM restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disks on VMs with SCSI disk controller
item.description:
Azure VM public preview adds multi-disk crash-consistent restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra data disks on VMs using SCSI disk controllers. It supports agent-less capture of crash-consistent restore points.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Instant Access for VM restore points
item.description:
Instant Access for application-consistent restore points on Azure virtual machines is now generally available. It lets you start restoring a disk from a restore point before the underlying snapshot copy completes, for VMs using Premium SSD v2 or Ultra disks as data disks.

  • Source: Azure Updates
